title: Add Technician in the Edit Line window offers only technicians
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician off, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, so the list has a technician to compare with.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Approved, led by staff member B, with one approved line, line 1, so the work order has a lead and a line.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open Edit Line for line 1.
  3. Open Add Technician.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The Edit Line window opens.

Step 3:

  • Add Technician offers staff member B.
  • Staff member A is not offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 18 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R6: “Add Technician on a line (in the New Line and Edit Line windows) and the Technician dropdown in the Edit Labor window offer only people per S3-R1.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793640819-ff4d, read 2 Nov 2026: page "6 Technician dropdowns on a work order", pictures "Add Technician on a line" (This build) and "Add Technician on a line" (Production today (before))

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p6-04-after-add-technician-on-a-line.png
  • tt-p6-03-before-add-technician-on-a-line.png

The design's own words:

  • “Not offered: Parth Fadadu follows Nikola Milosevic. Add Labor uses the same list.”
  • “Anyone already on a line who is not a technician any more stays on it. In Edit Line they show as an ordinary chip, not grayed out, removable with its X; the lock shows instead if they logged time on the line. Grayed out still means a deactivated technician, as today.”
  • “Add Technician open and scrolled to the O's: Olivia Garrett is offered.”

The design draws Add Technician in Edit Line; the New Line window is not drawn (register TT-N11).
